changelog: Device Monitor now reliably shows live pass-through readings: after switching a real load, Input / AC / Solar / Output and battery update within ~5 seconds instead of lagging on the 30-second cloud feed. The decoder that turns the device's pass-through reply into numbers is now tolerant of the exact shapes real hardware sends — the reply arriving as a plain string or an object, the payload encoded as base64 or hex, and a frame that trails an echoed request or gateway wrapper — so the live read sticks instead of silently falling back to the cloud value forever.
The device list's battery pass-through read and the cached rated-parameter read use the same hardened decode, so the list and the monitor agree on real-device readings.
